śataṃ vārān sahasraṃ vā pācayet sambhave sati||
aka5.42
doṣaghnāḥ saparīhārā vakṣyante snehabastayaḥ||
aka5.43
daśamūlaṃ balāṃ rāsnāmaśvagandhāṃ punarnavām|
guḍūcyairaṇḍapūtīkabhārṅgīvṛṣakarohiṣam||
aka5.44
śatāvarīṃ sahacaraṃ kākanāsāṃ palāṃśakam|
yavamāṣātasīkolakulatthān prasṛtonmitān||
aka5.45
vahe vipācya toyasya droṇaśeṣeṇa tena ca|
pacettailāḍhakaṃ peṣyairjīvanīyaiḥ palonmitaiḥ||
aka5.46
anuvāsanamityetat sarvavātavikāranut|
anūpānāṃ vasā tadvajjīvanīyopasādhitā||
aka5.47
śatāhvāyavabilvāmlaistailaṃ siddhaṃ samīraṇe|
saindhavenāgnivraṇena taptaṃ cānilajiddhṛtam||
aka5.48
jīvantīṃ madanaṃ medāṃ śrāvaṇīṃ madhukaṃ balām|
śatāhvarṣabhakau kṛṣṇāṃ kākanāsāṃ śatāvarīm||
aka5.49
svaguptāṃ kṣīrakākolīṃ karkaṭākhyāṃ śaṭhīṃ vacām|
piṣṭvā tailaṃ ghṛtaṃ kṣīre sādhayeta caturguṇe||
aka5.50
bṛṃhaṇaṃ vātapittaghnaṃ balaśukrāgnivardhanam|
rajaḥśukrāmayaharaṃ putrīyaṃ cānuva sanam||
aka5.51
śiśirasparśavīryaiśca piṣṭaiḥ kṣīre caturguṇe|
tailapādaṃ ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ pittaghnamanuvāsanam||
aka5.52
saindhavaṃ madanaṃ kuṣṭhaṃ śatāhvā niculo vacā|
drīberaṃ madhukaṃ bhārṅgī devadārusakaṭphalam||
aka5.53
nāgaraṃ puṣkaraṃ medā cavikā citrakaḥ śaṭhī|
viḍaṅgātiviṣe śyāmā hareṇurnīlinī sthirā||
aka5.54
bilvājamodacapalā dantī rāsnā ca taiḥ smaiḥ|
sādhyameraṇḍatailaṃ vā tailaṃ vā kapharoganut||
aka5.55
vardhmodāvartagulmārśaḥplīhamehāḍhyamārutān|
ānāhamaśmarīṃ cāśu hanyāttadanuvāsanam||
aka5.56
sādhitaṃ pañcamūlena tailaṃ bilvādināthavā|
anvāsanaṃ śleṣmaharaṃ dravyairvā kaphaghātibhiḥ|
phalairaṣṭaguṇe cāmle siddhamanvāsanaṃ kaphe||
aka5.57
śūlānāhe tu tadyukto nirūhaḥ paṭumūtravān|
pṛcchati sma munimityatha dhīmānagniveśa iha kintu phalānām|
bastikarmaṇi hitaṃ satataṃ syāt taṃ punarvasuriti praśaśāsa||
aka5.58
iha kuṣṭhahitā garāgarī hitamikṣvākuphalaṃ pramehiṇām|
kuṭajasya phalaṃ hṛdāmaye pravaraṃ kośaphalaṃ tu pāṇḍuṣu||
aka5.59
udare kṛtavedhanaṃ hitaṃ madanaṃ sarvagadāvirodhi ca|
madhuraṃ sakaṣāyatiktakaṃ tadarūkṣaṃ sakaṭūṣṇapicchilam||
aka5.60
kaphapittahṛdāśukāri yannirapāyaṃ pavanānulomi ca|
pravaraṃ tadataḥ phalādiṣu smṛtamāsthāpanayojanāsviti||
aka5.61
atha munivṛṣabhe nigadya vākyaṃ sthitavati vijñapayāmbabhūva bhūyaḥ|
idamatigahanaṃ sahānyaśiṣyairavanigato'ñjalimagrato nidhāya||
aka5.62
citrakarmaguṇakṛdguruṇokto bastirūrdhvamatha caiti na nābheḥ|
śīghnamāpatati cānu sa dehāt sarvataḥ kathamapohati doṣān||
aka5.63
ūce gurustimitamārutavaśyametat dehasya yadbahirupāśritamantare vā|
duṣṭasya tasya janayannanulomatāṃ tu bastirhinasti viṣamānapi rogapūgān||
aka5.64
śākhāgatāḥ koṣṭhagatāśca rogā marmordhvasarvāvayavāṅgajāśca|
ye santi teṣāṃ na tu kaścidanyo vāyoḥ paraṃ janmani heturasti||
aka5.65
viṭśleṣmapittādimalācayānāṃ vikṣepasaṃhārakaro hi vāyuḥ|
tasyātivṛddhasya śamāya nānyadbasteḥ samaṃ bheṣajamasti yasmāt||
aka5.66
śāmyanti yatnena jite'nile ca tadīritāḥ pittakaphādayo'pi|
tasmāccikitsārdhamiti bruvanti sarvāṃ cikitsāmapi bastimeke||
aka5.67
yacca pakvāśastho'pi doṣānāpādamastakam|
vīryeṇa bastirādatte khastho'rko bhūrasāniva||
aka5.68
yattatrauṣadhavīryaṃ hi tadapānena vāyunā|
paryāptamacirādeva samānaḥ pratipadyate||
aka5.69
samānādduttaraṃcaivaṃ vyānādyāḥ pavanāḥ kramāt|
te tṛptāḥ prakṛtiṃ yātāḥ śarīrānugrahe sthitāḥ||
aka5.70
prasahya pittaśleṣmāṇau yathāsthānaṃ niveśya ca|
santarpayanti paritaḥ svān svān bhūtaguṇāṃstanau||
aka5.71
vyānastiryagapāno'dhaḥ prāṇaścordhvaṃ prakarṣati|
yathāsvameva nāḍībhirhāriṇībhirivodakam||
aka5.72
evaṃ vātaiḥ sirābhiśca vapurbastiḥ suyojitaḥ|
vyāpnuvat prasabhaṃ hanti sakṛchrānapi yakṣmaṇaḥ||
aka5.73
bastistasmāt sarvakarmapradhānaṃ sarvātaṅkān hanti niḥśeṣataśca|
srotāṃsyantaḥ śodhayitvā ca kuryādojastejaḥ śukramedhāgnikīptim||
||iti pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ||
atha ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ|
aka6.1
athāto bastivyāpatsiddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ|
iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ||
aka6.2
vibandhagauravādhmānaśirorugvāhanordhvagāḥ|
kukṣiśūlāṅgarugghidhmāhṛtpīḍākartanasravāḥ|
ayogādatiyogācca basteḥ syuḥ ṣaṭṣaḍāpadaḥ||
aka6.3
asnigdhasvinnadehasya gurukoṣṭhasya yojitaḥ|
śīto'lpasnehalavaṇadravyamātro ghano'pi vā||
aka6.4
bastiḥ saṅkṣobhya taṃ doṣaṃ durbalatvādanirharan|
karoti vātaviṇmūtravibandhamatidāruṇam||
aka6.5
nābhibastirunāṃ dāhaṃ hṛllepaṃ śvayathuṃ gude|
kaṇḍūṃ gaṇḍāni vaivarṇyamaratiṃ vahnimārdavam||
aka6.6
kvāthadvayaṃ prāgvihitaṃ madhyedoṣe'tisāriṇi|
uṣṇasya tasmādekasya tatra pānaṃ praśasyate|
phalavartyastathā svedāḥ kālaṃ jñātvā virecanam||
aka6.7
bilvamūlatrivṛddāruyavakolakulatthavān|
surāviṇmūtravān bastiḥ saprākpeṣyastamānayet||
aka6.8
saśeṣāme nirūheṇa mṛdunā doṣa īritaḥ|
mūrchayatyanilaṃ mārgaṃ ruṇaddhyagniṃ hinasti ca||
aka6.9
gauravaklamahṛcchūladāhasammohaveṣṭanam|
tataḥ kuryādupacarettaṃ rūkṣasvedapācanaiḥ||
aka6.10
pippalīkattṛṇośīradārumūrvāśṛtaṃ jalam|
pibet sauvarcalonmiśraṃ dīpanaṃ hṛdviśodhanam||
aka6.11
vacānāgaraśaṭhyo vā dadhimaṇḍena mūrchitāḥ|
peyāḥ prasannayā vā syurariṣṭenāsavena vā||
aka6.12
dārutrikaṭukaṃ pathyāṃ palāśaṃ citrakaṃ śaṭhīm|
piṣṭvā kuṣṭhaṃ ca mūtreṇa pibet kṣārāṃśca dīpanān|
bastimasya vidaddhyācca samūtraṃ dāśamūlikam||
aka6.13
yukto'lpavīryo doṣāḍhye rūkṣe krūrāśaye'thavā|
bastirdoṣāvṛto rūddhamārgo rundhyāt samīraṇam||
aka6.14
savimārgo'nilaḥ kuryādādhmānaṃ marmapīḍanam|
vidāhaṃ gudakoṣṭhasya muṣkavaṅkṣaṇavedanām|
rūṇaddhi hṛdayaṃ śūlairitaścetaśca dhāvati||
aka6.15
svabhyaktasvinnagātrasya tatra vartiṃ prayojayet|
bilvādiśca nirūhaḥ syāt pīlusarṣapamūtravān|
saralāmaradārubhyāṃ sādhitaṃ cānuvāsanam||
aka6.16
bahudoṣe'bale krūrakoṣṭhe bastistanurmṛduḥ|
śīto'lpaścāvṛto doṣaiḥ pratihanti samīraṇam||
aka6.17
ūrdhvaṃ so'nusaran dehaṃ kuryādvāyuḥ śirorujam|
grīvāstambhaṃ pratiśyāyaṃ bādhiryaṃ dṛṣṭivibhramam||
aka6.18
tamuṣṇatailalavaṇapradigdhaṃ svinnamarditam|
tīkṣṇairdhūmaiḥ pradhamanairnasyairāsyavirecanaiḥ|
virekairbastibhiścāśu yojyedānulomikaiḥ||
aka6.19
snigdhasvinne mahādoṣe bastirmṛdvalpabheṣajaḥ|
utkleśyālpaṃ hareddoṣaṃ janayecca pravāhikām||
aka6.20
śophaṃ bastāvapāne ca sadanaṃ corujaṅkṣayoḥ|
vibaddhamāruto janturabhīkṣṇaṃ sa pravāhate||
aka6.21
svedābhyaṅganirūhāṃśca śodhanīyānulomikān|
vidadhyāllaṅkṣayitvā ca vṛttiṃ tasya viriktavat||
aka6.22
kurvato vegasaṃrodhaṃ pīḍito vātimātrayā|
asnigdhalavaṇoṣṇo vā bastiralpo'lpabheṣajaḥ||
aka6.23
mṛdurvā mārutenordhvaṃ vikṣipto mukhanāsikāt|
nireti mūrchāhṛllāsatṛḍdāhādīn pravartayan||
aka6.24
mūrchāvikāraṃ dṛṣṭvāsya siñcecchītāmbunā mukham|
vījedāklamanāśācca prāṇāyāmaṃ ca kārayet||
aka6.25
pṛṣṭhapārśvodaraṃ mṛdyāt karairuṣṇairadhomukham|
keśeṣūtkṣipya dhunvīta bhāyayedvyāladaṃṣṭribhiḥ|
śastrolkārajapuruṣairbastireti tathā hyadhaḥ||
aka6.26
pāṇivastrairgalāpīḍaṃ kuryānna mriyate yathā|
prāṇodānanirodhāddhi suprasiddhatarāyanaḥ|
apānaḥ pavano bastiṃ tamāśvevāpakarṣati||
aka6.27
kuṣṭhakramukakalkaṃ ca pāyayedamlasaṃyutam|
auṣṇyāttaikṣṇyāt saratvācca bastiṃtasosyānulomayet|
gomūtreṇa trivṛtpathyākalkaṃ vādhonulomanam||
aka6.28
pakvāśayasthite svinne nirūho dāśamūlikaḥ|
yavakolakulatthaiśca vidheyo mūtrasādhitaiḥ||
aka6.29
bastirgomūtrasiddhairvā sāmṛtāvaṃśapallavaiḥ|
pūtīkarañjatvakpatraśaṭhīdevāhvarohiṣaiḥ|
satailaguḍasindhūttho virekauṣadhakalkavān||
aka6.30
bilvādipañcamūlena siddho bastiruraḥsthite|
śirasthe nāvanaṃ dhūmaḥ pracchādyaṃ sarṣapaiḥ śiraḥ||
aka6.31
bastiratyuṣṇatīkṣṇāmlaghano'ti sveditasya vā|
alpadoṣe mṛdau koṣṭhe prayukto vā punaḥ punaḥ||
aka6.32
atiyogatvamāpannaḥ kukṣiśūlakaro bhavet|
virecanātiyogena sa tulyākṛtisādhanaḥ||
aka6.33
pṛśniparṇīṃ sthirāṃ padmaṃ kāśmaryaṃ madhukotpale|
piṣṭvā drākṣāṃ madhūkaṃ ca kṣīre taṇḍuladhāvane||
aka6.34
drākṣāyāḥ pakkaloṣṭasya prasāde madhukasya vā|
vinīya saghṛtaṃ bastiṃ yuñjyāddāhe'tiyogaje||
aka6.35
snehasvedairasampādya gurutīkṣṇo'timātrakaḥ|
duḥsthitāya praṇihito bastirduḥśodhitāya vā||
aka6.36
atipravṛtto marutaṃ kopayet sa vimārgagaḥ|
karotyaṅgarujāṃ jṛmbhāṃ stambhaṃ bhedaṃ ca parvaṇām||
aka6.37
taṃ tailalavaṇābhyaktaṃ sveditaṃ prastarādibhiḥ|
bilvakolayavairaṇḍavaṣārbhūbṛhatīdvayaḥi||
aka6.38
āsthāpayet sasindhūtthairjāṅgalairāśitaṃ rasaiḥ|
tailenānilajiddravyavipakvenānuvāsayet||
aka6.39
mṛdukoṣṭhe'bale bastiratitīkṣṇo'tinirharan|
kuryāddhidhmāṃ hitaṃ tatra hidhmāghnaṃ bṛṃhaṇaṃ ca yat||
aka6.40
balābṛhatyādivarākāśmaryaphalasaindhavaiḥ|
saprasannāranālāmlaistailaṃ paktvānuvāsayet||
aka6.41
uṣṇāmbunākṣaṃ pippalyā dadyāllavaṇasaṃyutam|
dhūmaleharasakṣīrasvedāṃścānnaṃ ca vātajit||
aka6.42
atitīkṣṇaḥ savāto vā na vā samyakprapīḍitaḥ|
ghaṭṭayeddhṛdayaṃ bastistatra kāśakuśotkaṭaiḥ||
aka6.43
syāt sāmlalavaṇaskandhakarīrabadarīnalaiḥ|
śṛtairbastirhitaḥ siddho vātaghnaiścānuvāsanam||
aka6.44
mṛdukoṣṭhālpadoṣasya rūkṣatīkṣṇātimātrakaḥ|
hṛtvā bastirmalāñchīghraṃ vātapitte prakopayet||
aka6.45
nābhibastigudāṃste hi kṛntato'sya muhurmuhuḥ|
vivarṇālpālpamutthānaṃ bastinirlekhanādbhavet||
aka6.46
svāduśītauṣadhaistatra payasyekṣvādibhiḥ śṛtaḥ|
yaṣṭhyāhvatilakalkena bastiḥsyāt kṣīrabhojinaḥ||
aka6.47
sasarjarasayaṣṭyāhvaṃ jiṅgaṇīkardamāñjanam|
vinīya dugdhe bastiḥ syādvyaktāmlarasabhojinaḥ|
picchilaśca hito bastiḥ snehaśca madhuraiḥ śṛtaḥ||
aka6.48
bastiḥkṣārāmlatīkṣṇoṣṇalavaṇaḥ paittikasya vā|
gudaṃ likhan dahan kṣiṇvan karotyasraparisravam||
aka6.49
sa vidagdhaṃ sravatyasraṃ varṇaiḥ pittaṃ ca bhūribhiḥ|
bahuśaścātiyogena mohaṃ gacchati cāsakṛt||
aka6.50
tatrārdraiḥ śālmalīpatraiḥ kṣuṇairājaṃ payaḥ śṛtam|
pūtaṃ ghṛtānvitaṃ bastiṃ dadyādanyāṃśca picchilān||
aka6.51
vaṭādipallaveṣvevaṃ kalpo yavatileṣu ca|
suvarcalopodakayoḥ kacchudāre ca śasyate||
aka6.52
gude ca śītamadhurān kuryāt sekapralepanān|
raktapittātisāraghnī kriyā cātra praśasyate||
aka6.53
dāhādiṣu trivṛtkalkaṃ mṛdvīkāvāriṇā pibet|
taddhi pittaśakṛdvātān hatvā dāhādikān jayet||
aka6.54
viśuddhaśca pibecchītāṃ yavāgūṃ śarkarāyutām|
yuñjyādvātiviriktasya kṣīṇaviṭkasya bhojanam|
māṣayūṣeṇa kulmāṣān pānaṃ dadhyathavā surām||
aka6.55
āmaṃ yaḥ kuṇapaṃ rugvānupaveśyeta sāruciḥ|
sa ghanātiviṣākuṣṭhanatadāruvacāḥ pibet||
aka6.56
śakṛdvātamasṛk pittaṃ kaphaṃ vā yo'tisāryate|
pakvaṃ tatra svavargīyo bastiḥ śeṣṭhaṃ bhiṣagjitam||
aka6.57
ṣaṇṇāmeṣāṃ dvisaṃsargāttriṃśadbhedā bhavanti tu|
kevalaiḥ sahaṣaṭtriṃśadvidyāt sopadravāṃśca tān||
aka6.58
śūlapravāhikādhmānaparikartārucijvarān|
tṛṇmohadāhamūrchādīṃścaiṣāṃ vidyādupadravān||
aka6.59
tatrāme'ntarapānaṃ tu kaṭvamlalavaṇairyutam|
pācanaṃ śasyate bastirāme hi pratiṣidhyate||
aka6.60
vātaghnagrāhivargīyo bastiḥ śakṛti śasyate|
svādvamlo vyaktalavaṇaḥ snehabastiḥ samīraṇe||
aka6.61
rakte raktena pitte tu kaṣāyasvādutiktakaḥ|
sāryamāṇe kaphe bastiḥ kaṣāyakaṭutiktakaḥ||
aka6.62
śakṛtā vāyunā vāme tena varcasi vānile|
saṃsṛṣṭe'ntarapānaṃ syāt kaṭvamlalavaṇairyutam||
aka6.63
pittenāme'sṛjā tadvat tayorāmena vā punaḥ|
saṃsṛṣṭayorbhavet pānaṃ sakaṭusvādutiktakam||
aka6.64
tathāme kaphasaṃsṛṣṭe kaṣāyakaṭutiktakam|
āmena tu kaphe yukte kaṣāyalavaṇoṣaṇam||
aka6.65
vātena viśi pitte vā viṭpittāsraistathānile|
syāt kaṣāyāmlamadhuraḥ saṃsṛṣṭe bastiruttamaḥ|
bastirvātena rakte tu kāryaḥ svādvamlatiktakaḥ||
aka6.66
śakṛcchoṇitayoḥ pittaśakṛtorasrapittayoḥ|
bastiranyonyasaṃsarge kasāyasvādutiktakaḥ||
aka6.67
kaphena viśi pitte vā kaphe viṭpittayoḥ|
kaṭutiktakaṣāyaḥ syāt saṃsṛṣṭe bastiruttamaḥ||
aka6.68
madhuroṣaṇatiktastu rakte kaphavimūrchite|
mārute kaphasaṃsṛṣṭe kaṭvamlalavaṇo bhavet|
syādbastiḥ kaṭutiktāmlaḥ saṃsṛṣṭe vāyunā kaphe||
aka6.69
tricatuḥpañcaṣaḍyogānevameva vikalpayet|
yuktiścaiṣātisāroktā sarvarogeṣvapi smṛtā||
aka6.70
yugapat ṣaḍrasaṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ saṃsarge pācanaṃ bhavet|
nirāmāṇāṃ tu pañcānāṃ bastiḥ ṣaḍsiko hitaḥ||
aka6.71
udumbaraśalāṭūni jambvāmrodumbaratvacaḥ|
śaṅkhaṃ sarjarasaṃ lākṣāṃ kattṛṇaṃ ca palāṃśikam||
aka6.72
piṣṭvā taiḥ sarpiṣaḥ prasthaṃ kṣīradviguṇitaṃ pacet|
atīsāreṣu sarveṣu peyametadyathābalam||
aka6.73
kacchurādhātakībilvasamaṅgāraktamūlibhiḥ|
masūrāśvatthaśuṅgaiśca yavāgūḥ syājjale śṛtaiḥ||
aka6.74
bālodumbarakaṭvaṅgasamaggāplakṣapallavaiḥ|
masūradhātakīpuṣpabalābhiśca tathā bhavet||
aka6.75
nānāprakārā jāyante vyāpado bastivibhramāt|
yathāyathaṃ yathāvasthaṃ tāsāṃ kurvīta sādhanam||
||iti ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ||
atha saptamo'dhyāyaḥ|
aka7.1
athātaḥ snehādivyāpatsiddhiṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ|
iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ||
aka7.2
snehabastau marutpittakaphātyāśāviḍāvṛte|
abhukte śūnapāyvāmadatte'ṣṭau vyāpadaḥ smṛtāḥ||
aka7.3
śīto'lpo vādhike vāte pittetyuṣṇaḥ kaphe mṛduḥ|
atibhukte gururvarcaḥsañcaye'lpabalastathā|
dattastairāvṛtaḥ sneho nāyātyabhibhavādapi||
aka7.4
stambhorusadanādhmānajvaraśūlāṅgamardanaiḥ|
pārśvarugveṣṭanairvidyādvāyunā snehamāvṛtam||
aka7.5
snigdhāmlalavaṇoṣṇaistaṃ rāsnāpītadrutailikaiḥ|
sauvīrakasurākolakulatthayavasādhitaiḥ||
aka7.6
nirūhairnirharet samyak samūtraiḥ pāñcamūlikaiḥ|
tābhyāmeva ca tailābhyāṃ sāyaṃ bhukte'nuvāsayet||
aka7.7
tṛḍdāharāgasammohavaivarṇyatamakajvaraiḥ|
vidyāt pittāvṛtaṃ svādutiktaistaṃ bastibhirharet||
aka7.8
tandrāśītajvarālasyaprasekārucigauravaiḥ|
samūrchāglānibhirvidyācchleṣmaṇā snehamāvṛtam||
aka7.9
kaṣāyatiktakaṭukaiḥ surāmūtropasādhitaiḥ|
phalatailayutaiḥ sāmlairbastibhistaṃ vinirharet||
aka7.10
chardimūrchāruciglāniśūlanidrāṅgamardanaiḥ|
āmaliṅgaiḥ sadāhaistaṃ vidyādatyaśanāvṛtam||
aka7.11
kaṭūnāṃ lavaṇānāṃ ca kvāthaiścūrṇaiśca pācanam|
mṛdurvirekaḥ sarvaṃ ca tatrāmavihitaṃ hitam||
aka7.12
viṇmūtrānilasaṅgārtigurutvādhmānahṛdgrahaiḥ|
snehaṃ viḍāvṛtaṃ jñātvā snehasvedaiḥ sabastibhiḥ||
aka7.13
śyāmābilvādisiddhaiśca nirūhaiḥ sānuvāsanaiḥ|
nirharedvidhinā samyagudāvartahareṇa ca||
aka7.14
abhukte śūnapāyorvā peyāmātrāśitasya vā|
gude praṇihitaḥ sneho vegāddhāvatyanāvṛtaḥ|
ūrdhvakāyaṃ tataḥ kaṇṭhādūrdhvebhyaḥ khebhya etyapi||
aka7.15
mūtraśyāmātrivṛtsiddho yavakolakulatthavān|
tatsiddhatailo deyaḥ syānnirūhaḥ sānuvāsanaḥ||
aka7.16
kaṇṭhādāgacchataḥ stambhakaṇṭhagrahavirecanaiḥ|
chardighnībhiḥ kriyābhiśca tasya kuryānnivartanam||
aka7.17
nāpakvaṃ praṇayet snehaṃ gudaṃ sa hyupalimpati|
tataḥ kuryāt saruṅmohakaṇḍūśophān kriyātra ca|
tīkṣṇo bastistathā tailamarkapatrarase śṛtam||
aka7.18
hrasvaṃ dīrghaṃ tanu sthūlaṃ jīrṇaṃ śithilabandhanam|
pārśvacchidraṃ tathā vakramaṣṭau netrāṇi varjayet||
aka7.19
aprāptyatigatikṣobhakarṣaṇanasravāḥ|
guḍapīḍā gatirjihmā teṣāṃ doṣā yathākramam||
aka7.20
māṃsalasnigdhaviṣamajālavatsthūlavātalaḥ|
chinnaḥ klinnaśca tānaṣṭau bastīn karmasu varjayet||
aka7.21
gativaiṣamyadaurgandhyajihmatvasrutidurgrahāḥ|
phenilacyutyadhāryatvaṃ basteḥ syurbastidoṣataḥ||
aka7.22
uccakairatyavākśīrṣaṃ nyubjaṃ saṅkucitaṃ sthitam|
uttānaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ pārśvaṃ sapta śayyāḥ parityajet||
aka7.23
mūtrāghāto'tisamprāptiraprāptiḥ sādhunāgatiḥ|
āśvāgatirmarutkopastṛptiḥ pakvāśayasya ca|
taddoṣāḥ syurvidhātavyaṃ yathaupayikamatra ca||
aka7.24
savātātidrutotkṣiptatiryagulluptakampitāḥ|
atimandakabāhyātivegadoṣāḥ praṇetṛtaḥ||
aka7.25
anucchravāsya tu baddhe vā datte niḥśeṣa eva vā|
praviśya kṣubhito vāyuḥ śūlatodakaro bhavet|
tatrābhyaṅgo gude svedo vātaghnānyaśanāni ca||
aka7.26
drutaṃ praṇīte niṣkṛṣṭe sahasotkṣipta eva vā|
syāt kaṭīgudajaṅkṣorubastistambhārtibhedanam||
bhojanaṃ tatra vātaghnaṃ svedābhyaṅgāḥ sabastayaḥ||
aka7.27
tiryagvalyāvṛte dvāre baddhe vāpi na gacchati|
netre tadṛju niṣkṛṣya saṃśodhya ca punarnayet||
aka7.28
pīḍyamāne'ntarāmukte gude pratihato'nilaḥ|
uraḥ śirorujaṃ sādamūrvośca janayedbalī|
bastiḥsyāttatrabilvādiḥ phalaśyāmādimūtravān||
aka7.29
syāddāho davathuḥ śophaḥ kampenābhihate gude|
kaṣāyamadhurāḥ śītāḥ sekāstatra sabastayaḥ||
aka7.30
atimātrapraṇītena netreṇa kṣaṇanādvaleḥ|
syāt sārtidāhanistodaguruvarcaḥpravartanam|
tatra sarpiḥ picuḥ kṣīraṃ picchābastiśca śasyate||
aka7.31
na bhāvayati mandastu bāhyaścāśu nivartate|
snehastatra punaḥ samyak praṇeyaḥ siddhimicchatā||
aka7.32
atiprapīḍitaḥ koṣṭhe tiṣṭhatyāyāti vā galam|
tatra bastirvirekaśca galapīḍādi karma ca||
aka7.33
vamanādyairviśuddhaṃ ca kṣāmadehabalānalam|
yathāṇḍaṃ taruṇaṃ pūrṇaṃ tailapātraṃ yathā tathā|
bhiṣak prayatnato rakṣet sarvasmādapacārataḥ||
aka7.34
dadyānmadhurahṛdyāni tato'mlalavaṇau rasau|
svādutiktau tato bhūyaḥ kaṣāyakaṭukau tataḥ||
aka7.35
anyonyapratyanīkānāṃ rasānāṃ snigdharūkṣayoḥ|
vyatyāsādupayogena kramāttaṃ prakṛtiṃ nayet|
sarvaṃsahaḥ sthirabalo vijñeyaḥ prakṛtiṃ gataḥ||
aka7.36
atrāntare tyajedaṣṭau bhāṣyādīni viśeṣataḥ|
uccairbhāṣyācchirorogatimiroraḥsvaravyathāḥ||
aka7.37
raktaniṣṭhīvatamakajvarādyāstatra sādhanam|
abhyaṅgasvedanasyādhobhaktasnehopasevanam|
maunaṃ vidhirvātaharo yathāsvaṃ ca vikārajit||
aka7.38
atyāsyāyānayānābhyāṃ sandhimūrdhatrikādiruk|
aticaṅkramaṇāt pādajaṅkṣorusadanādayaḥ||
aka7.39
teṣāṃ vātaharaṃ sarvaṃ snehasvedādi śasyate|
ajīrṇabhojanādāmaviṣacchardijvarādayaḥ||
aka7.40
tatra mātrāśitīyokto vidheyo vidhirāmahā|
ahitānnādyathādoṣaṃ rogāḥ syurbheṣajāni ca||
aka7.41
halīmakādayaḥ proktā divāsvapnāt purā gadāḥ|
vidadhyāt kaphajitteṣu dhūmarūkṣānnalaṅkṣanam||
aka7.42
vyavāyājjīvitabhraṃśastaistairasyānilāmayaiḥ|
gudo'valupyata iva bhramatīva ca cetanā||
aka7.43
meḍhraṃ dhūmāyati manastamasīva praveśyate|
jīvanīyaśṛtakṣīrasarpiṣorupasevanam|
āhāro bṛṃhaṇastatra vṛṣyāste te ca bastayaḥ||
aka7.44
vegarodhordhvavātatvāt prāguktā ye sadāturāḥ|
teṣāṃ vibaddhe pavane sarvadehopatāpitni|
phalavartiṃ purā dadyādatha bastiṃ calāpaham||
aka7.45
nikumbhakumbhāgnyurubūkadhāvanīpunarnavaṃ dāru mahacca pañcakam|
phalaṃ ca mūtre kvathitaṃ samastu tat ghṛtaṃ satailaṃ lavaṇāni pañca ca||
aka7.46
nirūhitaṃ dhanvarasena bhojayennikumbhatailena tato'nuvāsayet|
balāṃ sarāsnāṃ phalabilvacitrakān dvipañcamūlaṃ kṛtamālakāt phalam||
aka7.47
yavān kulatthāṃśca pacejjale rasaḥ samustapāṭhendrayavaiśca kalkavān|
satailasarpirguḍasaindhavo hitaḥ sadāturāṇāṃ balapuṣṭivarṇadaḥ||
aka7.48
tathānuvāsyaṃ madhukena sādhitaṃ phalena bilvena śatāhvayāthavā|
sajīvanīyastu raso'nuvāsane nirūhaṇe cālavaṇaḥ śiśorhitaḥ||
aka7.49
nirūhabasternaivānyat pathyaṃ sthavirabālayoḥ|
balāṅgavardhanaṃ śīghramādṛto yojayedataḥ||
||iti saptamo'dhyāyaḥ||
atha aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ|
aka8.1
athāto bheṣajakalpaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ|
iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ||
aka8.2
jāṅgale sādhāraṇe vā deśe yathākālaṃ śiśirātapapavanasalilasevite same śucau pradakṣiṇodake śmaśānacaityadevayajanāgārasabhāśvabhrārāmavalmīkoṣaravirahite kuśarohiṣāstīrṇe snigdhakṛṣṇasuvarṇamadhurasurabhimṛttike mṛdāvaphālakṛṣṭenupahatenyairbalvattarairdrumairbheṣajāni praśasyanta iti sāmānyato bhūmiparīkṣā||
aka8.3
viśeṣatastvaśmavatī sthirā gurvī śyāmā kṛṣṇā sthūlatṛṇavṛkṣasasyaprāyā svaguṇabhūyiṣṭhā|
snigdhā śītalāsannodakā snigdhatṛṇasasyakomalavṛkṣaprāyā śuklācāmbuguṇabhūyiṣṭhā|
nānāvarṇalaghvalpapuṣpavatī praviralapāṇḍuvṛkṣaprarohāgniguṇabhūyiṣṭhā|
rūkṣā rāsabhabhasmavarṇā rūkṣatanukoṭaravṛkṣaprāyālparasaprarohānilaguṇabhūyiṣṭhā|
mṛdvī samā śvabhravatyavyaktarasajalā mahāparvatavṛkṣā śyāmā cākāśaguṇabhūyiṣṭhā|
tatrāmbupṛthivīguṇabhūyiṣṭhāsu bhūmiṣu jātāni virecanāni bṛṃhaṇāni ca śasyante|
analānilākāśaguṇabhūyiṣṭhāsu vamanāni|
sarvaguṇayuktāsūbhayatobhāgāni|
ākāśaguṇabhūyiṣṭhāsu śamanāni|
evaṃ balavattamāni bhavanti||
aka8.4
tatra yāni kālajānyupagatasampūrṇapramāṇarasavīryagandhāni kālātapāgnisalilapavanaśastrajantubhiranupahatagandhavarṇarasasparśaprabhāvānyavagāḍhamūlānyudīcyāṃ diśi sthitāni|
teṣāṃ śākhāpalāśamaciraprarūḍhaṃ varṣāvasantayorgrāhyam|
grīṣme mūlāni śiśire vā śīrṇaprarūḍhaparṇānām|
śaradi tvakkandakṣīrāṇi|
hemante sārāṇi|
yathartu puṣpaphalam||
aka8.5
anye punarāhuḥ saumyānyauṣadhāni saumyeṣvṛtuṣvāgneyānyāgneyeṣu|
evamavyāpannānyāpūrṇatararasavīryāṇi ca bhavanti||
aka8.6
atha maṅgalācāraḥ kalyāṇavṛttaḥ śuciḥ śuklavāsāḥ sampūjya ca devatāmaśvinau gobrāhmaṇāṃśca kṛtopavāsaḥ prāṅmukha udaṅmukho vā gṛhṇīyāt|
gṛhītvā cānurūpaguṇavadbhājanasaṃsthānyagāreṣu pūrvottaradvāreṣu nivātapravātaikadeśeṣu nityapuṣpopahārabalikarmavatsvagnisalilopasvedadhūmarajomūṣikacatuṣpadāmanabhigamanīyāni svavacchannāni śikyeṣvāsajya sthāpayet||
aka8.7
tāni sakṣīrāṇyupakalpayet|
tadasampattāvanatikrāntavatsarāṇi|
purāṇāni tu pippalīviḍaṅgaguḍamadhughṛtāni||
aka8.8
api ca|
kṣīraṃ bāṣkayaṇaṃ grāhyaṃ viṇmūtraṃ tacca nīrujām|
vayobalavatāṃ dhātupicchaśṛṅgakhurādikam||
aka8.9
pañcavidhastu bheṣajānāṃ kaṣāyakalpaḥ|
niryāsaḥ kalko niryūhaḥ śītaḥ phāṇṭaśca|
te yathāpūrvaṃ balinaḥ||
aka8.10
tatra sadyaḥsamuddhṛtaprakṣālitakṣuṇṇasya tāntavaniṣpīḍitasya svaraso niryāsaḥ|
upaladaśanādipiṣṭastu kalkaḥ|
śuṣkapiṣṭaḥ sūkṣmatāntavapaṭacyutaścūrṇaḥ|
tasya samastadravyāparityāgādāplutopayogācca kalkādabhedaḥ|
kvātho niryūhaḥ||
aka8.11
tatra bhedyānyauṣadhānyaṇuśo bhedayitvā chedayitvā chedayāni prakṣālyodakena śucaurūkṣāyāmadhaḥpraliptāyāṃ tāmrāyomṛnmayānyatamāyāṃ sthālyāṃ samāvāpya bahvalpapānīyagrāhitāmauṣadhānāmākalayya yāvatā muktarasatā syāt tāvadudakamāsecayecchoṣayecca|
athāgnāvadhiśritya mahatyāsane sukhopaviṣṭaḥ sarvataḥ satatamavalokayan darvyāvaghaṭṭayan mṛdunā paritaḥ samupagacchatānalena sādhayet|
avatārya ca parisrutaṃ yathārhasparśaṃ prayuñjīta||
aka8.12
kṣīrādisahitaṃ ca dravyaṃ na samyaṅmuktarasaṃ bhavatīti vārikvāthapūrvakaṃ kṣīrādyaistadupadeśe anupadagdhaṃ kvāthayet||
aka8.13
śītasalilāplutastu niśāparyuṣitapūtaḥ śītaḥ|
uṣṇāmbhasi kṣuṇṇābhiṣutapūtaḥ phāṇṭaḥ||
aka8.14
tatra samyagrasavīryādīnyauṣadhasya samīkṣya vyādhyāturādibalataśca niryāsādīnāṃ kalpanāṃ mātrāṃ ca saṃśrayet||
aka8.15
tathā ca kecidāhuḥ|
mātrāyā na vyavasthāsti vyādhiṃ koṣṭhaṃ balaṃ vayaḥ|
ālocya deśakālau ca yojyā tadvacca kalpanā||
aka8.16
ityalametadupadiṣṭaṃ buddhimatāṃ jñānaprabodhāya|
yathā tu sarvabhiṣajo vijñāsyanti tathopadekṣyate|
niryāsasya madhyamā mātrā catuṣpalam|
kalkacūrṇayoḥ karṣaḥ palatrayaṃ tadāloḍane||
aka8.17
niryūhe bheṣajapalamudakārdhaprasthe'dhiśritya pādaśeṣitamavatārayet||
aka8.18
śītaphāṇṭayorauṣadhapalaṃ ṣaṭcaturbhirambupalairāsutamiti||
aka8.19
snehapāke tvanirdiṣṭapramāṇe samuditasya dravasya pādena sneho yojyastatpādena kalkaḥ||
aka8.20
anye punaḥ paṭhanti|
snehapāke tvamānoktau caturguṇavivardhitam|
kalkasnehadravaṃ yojyamadhīte śaunakaḥ punaḥ||
aka8.21
snehe sidhyati śuddhāmbuniṣkvāthasvarasaiḥ kramāt|
kalkasya yojayedaṃśaṃ caturthaṃ ṣaṣṭhamaṣṭamam||
aka8.22
pañcaprabhṛti tu dravaṃ pṛthak snehasamamevāvapet|
anirūpitakalpanaṃ ca bhaiṣajyaṃ kalkīkuryāt|
athaikadhyaṃ pratisaṃsṛjyādhiśritya ca niryūhavatsādhayet||
aka8.23
tatra yadā viramati śabdaḥ prasādamāpadyate sneho yathāsvaṃ varṇagandharasotpattirbhaiṣajyamaṅgulībhyāṃ mṛdyamānamanatimṛdvanatidāruṇamanaṅguligrāhi ca syāt|
sa kālastasyāvataraṇāya||
aka8.24
api ca|
ghṛtasya phenopaśamastailasya tu tadudbhavaḥ|
lehasya tantumattāpsu majjanaṃ saraṇaṃ na ca||
aka8.25
athāvatārya śītībhūtamahatena vāsasā paripūya śucau dṛḍhe kalaśe samāsicyāpidhānena pidhāya śuklena vastrapaṭṭenāvacchādya sūtreṇa subaddhaṃ svanuguptaṃ śucau deśe susthitaṃ sthāpayet||
aka8.26
parimāṇaṃ punaḥ ṣaḍvaṃśyo marīciḥ|
tāḥ ṣaṭsarṣapaḥ|
te'ṣṭau taṇḍulaḥ|
tau dhānyamāṣaḥ|
tau yavaḥ|
ataḥ paraṃ caturguṇavṛdhyāṇḍikāmāṣakaśāṇakarṣapalakuḍavaprasthāḍhakadroṇavahāḥ kalpyante|
dharaṇaṃ tu palasya daśamo bhāgaḥ|
māṣakasya paryāyo hemo dhānakaśca|
śāṇadvayasya paryāyo draṅkṣaṇaḥ kolo vaṭakaśra|
karṣasya suvarṇamakṣaṃ picurbiḍālapadakaṃ pāṇitalaṃ tindukaṃ kavalagrahaḥ ṣoḍaśikā ca|
karṣadvayasya śuktiraṣṭamikā ca|
palasya muṣṭiḥ prakuñcaścaturthikā bilvamāmraṃ ca|
paladvayasya prasṛto'ṣṭamānaṃ ca|
kuḍavasyāñjaliḥ|
kuḍavadvayasya mānikā|
āḍhakasya pātraṃ kaṃsaśca|
droṇasya nalvaṇārmaṇonmānaghaṭakumbhakalaśāḥ|
droṇadvayasya śūrpaḥ|
tulā punaḥ palaśataṃ tāni viṃśatirbhāra iti|
bhavati cātra||
aka8.27
śuṣkameyeṣvidaṃ mānaṃ dviguṇaṃ tu dravārdrayoḥ||
aka8.28
peṣaṇāloḍane vāri snehapāke ca nirdrave||
aka8.29
kalpayetsadṛśān bhāgān pramāṇaṃ yatra noditam||
aka8.30
anirdiṣṭāprasiddheṣu mūlaṃ grāhyaṃ tvagādiṣu||
aka8.31
snehapākastridhā mandaścikkaṇaḥ kharacikkaṇaḥ|
mandaḥ kalkasame kiṭṭe cikkaṇo madanopame||
aka8.32
kiñcit sīdati kṛṣṇe ca vartyamāne tu paścimaḥ|
dagdho'taurdhvaṃ niṣkāryaḥ syādāmastvagnisādakṛt|
mṛdurnasye kharo'bhyaṅge pāne bastau ca cikkaṇaḥ||
aka8.33
himavadvindhyaśailābhyāṃ prāyo vyāptā vasundharā|
saumyaṃ pathyaṃ ca tatrādyamāgneyaṃ vaindhyamauṣadham||
samāptamidaṃ kalpasthānam|
paribhāṣā
akapa.1
paribhāṣāḥ pravakṣyante cikitsāyāṃ susaṃśritāḥ|
dravyāṇi ṣoḍaśaguṇe salile kvāthayet bhiṣak||
akapa.2
caturthaśeṣaḥ pūtastu kaṣāyo grāhya iṣyate|
atha kvāthyeṣu teṣūktaṃ toyādanyat drava bhavet||
akapa.3
taccāmbuvat prayoktavyaṃ tat ṣoḍaśaguṇaṃ tataḥ|
dravaṃ yattatra paṭhitaṃ kṣīraṃ vā dadhimastu vā||
akapa.4
mūtraṃ takraṃ surāmaṇḍaṃ yadi vāpyamlakāñjikam|
jalavat ṣoḍaśaguṇaṃ tat syāt pādāvaśeṣitam||
akapa.5
anirdiṣṭe pramāṇe tu kvāthyānāṃ ca dravasya ca|
kaṣāyapākakalpo'yaṃ kṛṣṇātreyeṇa varṇitaḥ||
akapa.6
kartavyaṃ sati nirdeśe yathānirdiṣṭameva hi|
asyāstu paribhāṣāyāḥ ṣaḍaṅgādāvasambhavāt||
akapa.7
tatra prasiddhimāśritya bheṣajeṣu jaleṣu ca|
tathā vidheyā bhāgāḥ syurvyādhyādisadṛśā yathā||
akapa.8
tasmādardhapalaṃ vāpi karṣannayamathāpi vā|
dravyāṇāṃ syāt palaṃ vāpi dviprasthamudakasya tu||
akapa.9
tatodhikaṃ vā kartavyamūhāpohaviśāradaiḥ|
hīnaṃ vāpi tataḥ kāryamevaṃ yūṣe ca pānake||
akapa.10
māṃsaudanāsavāriṣṭapeyāsu ca vitarkayet|
snehādisādhanāyokto niryūho yatra tatra hi||
akapa.11
tatrāpi ṣoḍaśaguṇaḥ pakṣoyaṃ parigṛhyate|
dravyaṃ snehasamaṃ kvāthyamatra pakṣe prayujyate||
akapa.12
kaṣāya eva cettatra dravārthaṃ kevalo bhavet|
tathānyadapi tatroktaṃ dravaṃ kṣīrādikaṃ bhavet||
akapa.13
tatonurūpaṃ saṅkhyāya dravyaṃ toyena sādhayet|
dravyaṃ snehasamaṃ kvāthyamanyatrāpi drave sati||
akapa.14
na tatra yujyate tasmādanurūpeṇa kalpayet|
anyetu bhiṣajaḥprāhuḥ kvāthyānyaṣṭaguṇe'mbhasi||
akapa.15
kvāthyaṃ tu bhavati snehādatra dviguṇamauṣadham|
kaṣāyeṇaiva cet sādhyaḥ satyanyasmin drave tathā||
akapa.16
sādhayedanurūpeṇa kecidevaṃ pracakṣate|
caturguṇena toyena kvāthayedauṣadhāni tu||
akapa.17
ṛṣīṇāṃ suśrutādīnāṃ sarveṣāṃ matamīdṛśam|
etāvāṃstu viśeṣo'tra śeṣamātrāpi pūrvavat||
akapa.18
kvāthyaṃ tu bheṣajaṃ snehādatra pakṣe caturguṇam|
palavyapekṣayā dravyādatha toyaṃ caturguṇam||
akapa.19
prasthavyapekṣayā dravyādyadā toyaṃ caturguṇam|
kriyate dviguṇaṃ kvāthyaṃ tataḥ snehāt prayujyate||
akapa.20
dravāṇāṃ dviguṇaṃ prasthaṃ śuṣkāt prasthādyato mataḥ|
prasiddhistu cikitsāyāṃ dvidhā hi bhiṣajāmiha||
akapa.21
palavyapeksayāpyasti tathā prasthavyapekṣayā|
suśrutasya tu yaḥ pūrvamupanyastaścirantanaḥ|
pāṭhaḥ palavyapekṣāyāṃ jñāpakaṃ tadudāhṛtam||
akapa.22
ityevaṃ trividhaḥ proktaḥ kaṣāyagrahaṇaṃ prati|
evamanyatra sarveṣāṃ kalkāt snehaścaturguṇaḥ||
akapa.23
caturguṇaṃ dravaṃ snehādyatra yat paṭhyate dravam|
anukte tu drave deyaṃ jalameva caturguṇam||
akapa.24
kalkakalpastu carake kaṣāyāṇāṃ na kīrtitaḥ||
akapa.25
snehapākavidhistūkta evaṃ dṛḍhabalena tu|
carako'rdhakṛte śāstre brahmabhūyaṃ gato yataḥ||
akapa.26
kaṣāyasya tu peyasya yadi vā kalkacūrṇayoḥ|
mātrā dṛḍhabalenāpi tatreti paribhāṣitā||
akapa.27
carakoktairmayā vākyairanumānāt prasādhitā|
anuktāpi yathā mātrā pañcādvakṣyāmyahaṃ tathā||
akapa.28
eṣāṃ kaṣāyakalpānāṃ pravibhāgo vidhīyate|
kaṣāyakalpe trividhe yaścaturguṇitodakaḥ||
akapa.29
kaṣāyakalpaḥ sneheṣu sādhyeṣveva samāśritaḥ|
vaidyaiḥ prāyeṇa na tathā yaḥ ṣoḍaśaguṇodakaḥ||
akapa.30
caturguṇodake pakṣe snehāddravyaṃ caturguṇam|
aṣṭāviṃśaṃ palaśataṃ kvāthyadravyasya jāyate||
akapa.31
snehaprasthe vipaktavye śuṣkaṃ tacca bhavedyadi|
ārdraṃ ceduddhṛtaṃ sadyastataḥ palaśatadvayam||
akapa.32
snehaprasthe bhavetsādhye ṣaṭpañcāśat palādhikam|
evaṃ bahutvāt dravyasya yaścaturguṇitodakaḥ||
akapa.33
sakalpo'bhimatastatra snehaḥ syādvīryavattaraḥ|
sahasrapākāḥ snehāstu śatapākāśca kīrtitāḥ||
akapa.34
subhāvitaṃ svalpamapi dravyaṃ tadbahukarmakṛt|
tasmādbahutaraṃ dravyaṃ yatra pakṣe prayujyate||
akapa.35
snehapākeṣu saḥ śreyānityeṣa tu mayāśritaḥ|
snehapākavidhāveva prayogastasya yujyate||
akapa.36
pācanāḥ śamanīyāśca ye kaṣāyā jvarādiṣu|
udīritāḥ punasteṣu kaṣāyeṣūpakalpyate||
akapa.37
caturguṇādaka peyaṃ kaṣāyasya palaṃ bhavet|
tasmāddravyapalaṃ vaidyāḥ pācaneṣu prayuñjate||
akapa.38
mātrāṃ tu vaidyāḥ kvāthasya pāyayanti catuṣpalām|
kriyamāṇaḥ prasiddho'yaṃ pāramparyāgato vidhiḥ||
akapa.39
vādhituṃ śakyate naiva jñāpakaṃ cātra vidyate|
palaṃ vatsakabījasya śrapayitvā rasaṃ pibet||
akapa.40
ācāryacarakeṇaivamatisāre tu bhāṣitam|
paṭolādye kaṣāye ca kvāthyadravyapalaṃ kṛtam||
akapa.41
caturguṇena toyena paceddravyapale sati|
caturbhāgāvaśeṣaṃ tu peyaṃ kvāthapalaṃ bhavet||
akapa.42
śāstre kuṣṭhe ca mātrā sā mahatī samprakāśitā|
catuṣpalā kaṣāyasya mātrā yā bhiṣajāṃ matā||
akapa.43
pale caturguṇajale sā mātrā na prasidhyati|
evaṃ sati ca sādhyaṃ syādbheṣajānāṃ catuṣpalam||
akapa.44
catuṣpalasya dravyasya kvathitasya caturguṇe|
toye caturthaśeṣasya peyaḥ kvāthaścatuṣpalaḥ||
akapa.45
bhaṭṭāraharicandreṇa kharaṇāde prakīrtitā|
pātavyā ṣaṭpalā mātrā tasya dravyapalāni ṣaṭ||
akapa.46
kvāthāni saṃprayujyante jalaṃ dravyāccaturguṇam|
paṭolādye ca tenāpi kvāthyadravyapalaṃ kṛtam||
akapa.47
kharaṇādakṛtā mātrā peyā tenaiva ṣaṭpalā|
parasparaviruddhaṃ tattasyāpyetat prayujyate||
akapa.48
aprasiddho vidhiścāyaṃ kaṣāyasya jvarādiṣu|
na ṣaṭpalāni kvāthyante na ca toyaṃ caturguṇam||
akapa.49
caturguṇodakā tasmāt paribhāṣā na yujyate|
jvarādīnāṃ kaṣāyeṣu sneheṣveva hi sā matā||
akapa.50
kṛṣṇātreyamuniproktā yā ṣoḍaśaguṇodakā|
jvarādiṣu kaṣāyāṇāṃ grahaṇaṃ kriyate tayā||
akapa.51
caturguṇodakā yāpi paribhāṣopadiśyate|
tatrāpi hi viśeṣo'yamanyaḥ kaiścidupāśritaḥ||
akapa.52
sneheṣu palanirdeśo yeṣu na vidyate|
prasthavyapekṣayā cātra saṅkhyeyamudakauṣadham||
akapa.53
palavyapekṣayā cāpi samācāro dvidhā api|
pūrvaṃ prasthavyapekṣā yā proktā vijñāpake sati||
akapa.54
dravyāṇāṃ palanirdeśo yatrokto miśrake tathā|
palavyapekṣayaivātra toyamevaṃ caturguṇam||
akapa.55
pradeśāntaranirdeśāccarake'pyanumīyate|
kaṣāyamātrā pātavyā yadyapyaparibhāṣitā||
akapa.56
svarṇakṣīryādike yoge pāṇḍurogacikitsite|
pātavyā kathitā mātrā gomūtreṇa catuṣpalā||
akapa.57
rohiṇīkaṭukādīnāṃ pittagulmacikitsite|
ghṛtaṃ muktvā kaṣāyasya proktā mātrā catuṣpalā||
akapa.58
ato'numānāccarake siddhā mātrā catuṣpalā|
dravyāṇāṃ ca palaṃ kvāthyaṃ paṭolādye prakīrtitam||
akapa.59
palaṃ vatsakabījasya nirdiṣṭaṃ cātisārike|
tat ṣoḍaśaguṇe toye yadi na kvāthyate tataḥ||
akapa.60
caturguṇodake toye peyaṃ kvāthapalaṃ bhavet|
ityetat ṣoḍaśaguṇaṃ toyaṃ yatra prayujyate||
akapa.61
eṣaiva carakasyāpi paribhāṣānumīyate|
pātavyeṣu kaṣāyeṣu mustaparpaṭakādiṣu||
akapa.62
viśeṣaḥ kathyate'nyo'pi māne śuṣkadravāśraye|
śuṣkadravyāśrayaṃ mānaṃ nirdiśya yadudāhṛtam||
akapa.63
draveṣu dviguṇaṃ mānaṃ sadyaścaivoddhṛteṣu ca|
dviguṇaṃ mānamityetadārabhya kuḍavāditi||
akapa.64
śuṣkāṇāṃ ca dravāṇāṃ ca samaṃ tu kuḍavādadhaḥ|
tulāyāmapi naiveṣṭā dviguṇā mānakalpanā||
akapa.65
tulāpalaśataṃ caiva tacchruṣkadravayormatam|
palaṃ caturguṇaṃ ceṣṭaṃ prasiddhajñāpakādikam||
akapa.66
sahācaratulāyāstu rase tailāḍhakaṃ pacet|
yaduktaṃ śatamevātra palānāṃ parigṛhyate||
akapa.67
catuḥsuvarṇametacca palaṃ nāṣṭasuvarṇakam|
dravyasya dviguṇatve syāt palamaṣṭasuvarṇakam||
akapa.68
naivāñjalau na prasṛte na pale na palādadhaḥ|
dravāṇāmauṣadhānāṃ hi dviguṇaṃ mānamiṣyate||
akapa.69
dviguṇatve draveṣu syāt palamaṣṭasuvaṇakam|
tenaiṣāṃ dviguṇatvena kriyāmārgo virudhyate||
akapa.70
kuḍavādyāsu saṃjñāsu dravāṇāṃ dviguṇo vidhiḥ|
vidyate jñāpakaṃ cātra carakācāryadarśitam||
akapa.71
spaṣṭārthameva paṭhitamidaṃ kuṣṭhacikitsite|
salilāḍhake'ṣṭabhāge śeṣe pūto raso grāhyaḥ||
akapa.72
te ca kaṣāyāṣṭapale catuṣpalaṃ sarpiṣaśca paktavyam|
yāvatsyādaṣṭapalaṃ śeṣaṃ peyaṃ tataḥ koṣṇamiti||
akapa.73
aṣṭabhāgāvaśeṣe tu palānāmaṣṭakadvayam|
palasya dviguṇe māne kriyamāṇe na yujyate||
akapa.74
dviguṇe hi pale tat syādekameva palāṣṭakam|
catuṣpalaṃ ca dātavyaṃ yat proktaṃ saha sarpisā||
akapa.75
palasya dviguṇe māne tadapyaṣṭapalaṃ bhavet|
catuḥsuvarṇaṃ hi palaṃ śuṣkāṇāmiṣyate yataḥ||
akapa.76
dviguṇatvāt dravāṇāṃ hi tat syādaṣṭasuvarṇakam|
nirūhamātrānirdeśa evaṃ sati ca bādhyate||
akapa.77
prasṛtārdhaṃ samārabhya dvādaśa prasṛtāḥ param|
eṣā mātrā dviguṇitā dviguṇe prasṛte bhavet||
akapa.78
nirūhamātrā śāstroktā dvādaśaprasṛtāstathā|
catvāriṃśat palāni syuraṣṭābhiradhikāni ca||
akapa.79
vyādhyādiṣu tu madhyeṣu kvāthasyāñjaliriṣyate|
atra suśrutanidaśe kvātho'yaṃ dviguṇo bhavet||
akapa.80
svarasāt kvathitācchītāt kaṣāyāt ṣaṭpalaṃ pibet|
yaduktaṃ kharaṇādena taddvādaśapalaṃ bhavet||
akapa.81
paittike paṭhyate gulme sarpiṣaśca catuṣpalam|
pibet saṃmūrchitaṃ tena gulmaḥ śāmyati paittikaḥ||
akapa.82
catuṣpalaṃ ghṛtasyedaṃ mātrāpyaṣṭapalaṃ bhavet|
svarṇakṣīryādike yoge gomūtrāñjaliriṣyate||
akapa.83
añjalerdviguṇatvāddhi mātrā sāṣṭapalā bhavet|
gaulmike trāyamāṇādye ghṛte ca paripaṭhyate||
akapa.84
rasasyāmalakekṣūṇāṃ kṣīrasya ca ghṛtasya ca|
palāni pṛthagaṣṭāṣṭau kṛtvā samyagvipācayet||
akapa.85
aṣṭau pratyekametāni syuḥ ṣoḍaśa palāni tu|
tasmādevaṃprakāreṣu nirdeśeṣu virudhyate||
akapa.86
dravāṇāṃ dviguṇaṃ mānaṃ tatkāryaṃ kuḍavādiṣu|
ārdreṣvapi na sarveṣu sadyasteṣūdghṛteṣu ca||
akapa.87
dviguṇaṃ mānamicchanti viśeṣo'tra ca kalpyate|
śuṣkāṇi viniyujyante daśamūlādikāni hi||
akapa.88
teṣveva dviguṇaṃ mānaṃ na sarveṣūdghṛteṣu hi|
ārdrāṇāmeva yeṣāṃ tu prasiddhimupakalpayet||
akapa.89
vāsāghṛte vṛṣaghṛte taile sāhacare tathā|
ārdrāṇāṃ dviguṇaṃ mānamevamādiṣu neṣyate||
akapa.90
ārdrāṇāmeva teṣāṃ hi prayogaḥ śasyate yataḥ|
śatāvarīmūlatulāścatasro yāḥ prakīrtitāḥ||
akapa.91
nai tatra dviguṇaṃ mānaṃ bhiṣagbhiḥ kaiścidāśritam|
vadyabuddhivikāsārthamidamanyat prakāśyate||
akapa.92
kvāthyānāmauṣadhānāṃ hi pramāṇaṃ yatra noditam|
caturguṇaṃ ca nirdiṣṭamanyat kṣīrādikaṃ dravam||
akapa.93
kaṣāyo'pyauṣadhānāṃ hi tatra kāryaścaturguṇaḥ|
udāharaṇamatreṣṭaṃ mahākalyāṇakaṃ ghṛtam||
akapa.94
evamevauṣadhānāṃ hi pramāṇaṃ yatra noditam|
dviguṇaṃ cāpi nirdiṣṭamanyat kṣīrādikaṃ dravam||
akapa.95
kaṣāyo'pyauṣadhānāṃ hi dviguṇastatra yujyate|
vāsādikaṃ jvare proktamatrodāharaṇaṃ smṛtam||
akapa.96
nirdiṣṭaṃ kṣīramanyadvā dravaṃ yatra caturguṇam|
kvāthauṣadhānāṃ mānaṃ ca proktaṃ noktaṃ jalasya tu||
akapa.97
tatroṣadhivaśādeva saṅkhyā kvāthasya gamyate|
caturguṇodakā tatra paribhāṣā yadīṣyate||
akapa.98
tato dravyasamastatra kaṣāyaḥ parikalpyate|
yadā tu paribhāṣeṣṭā yā ṣoḍaśaguṇodakā||
akapa.99
caturthaśeṣaḥ kvāthaḥ syāttato dravyāccaturguṇaḥ|
atra sāhacaraṃ tailamudāharaṇāmiṣyate||
akapa.100
yatrauṣadhaṃ kaṣāyo'pi dravaṃ kṣīrādikaṃ trayam|
pramāṇaṃ tu tathā noktaṃ snehasyoktaṃ na vā bhavet||
akapa.101
tulyaṃ kvāthena dātavyaṃ tatra kṣīrādikaṃ dravam|
kartavyaṃ ca tathā tat syādyathā snehāccaturguṇam||
akapa.102
gaulmiko miśrakasneha udāharaṇamatra hi|
evaṃ vai dviguṇe snehāt triguṇe ca prakīrtite||
akapa.103
kṣīrādike drave kāryaṃ kaṣāyagrahaṇaṃ tathā|
yathā kaṣāyasahitaṃ dravaṃ syāttaccaturguṇam||
akapa.104
atrodāharaṇaṃ tat syādyathāsnehāccaturguṇaḥ|
kaṣāyaḥ paṭhyate yatra pramāṇaṃ cāsya noditam||
akapa.105
caturguṇaṃ vāpyadhikaṃ proktaṃ kṣīrādikaṃ dravam|
tatrāpi ca prayoktavyaṃ snehāt kvāthaṃ caturguṇam||
akapa.106
pañcamūlakaṣāyeṇa piṇyākaṃ bahuvārṣikam|
paṭhyate vātaroge tadudāharaṇamatra hi||
akapa.107
bahūni yatra paṭhyante kvacit snehe dravāṇi hi|
bahūnāmapi teṣāṃ ca parimāṇaṃ na paṭhyate||
akapa.108
sarveṣāṃ samudāyaḥ syāttatra snehāccaturguṇaḥ|
snehapākavidhiṃ kecidevaṃ samanucakṣate||
akapa.109
bahuṣvekaikamicchanti kecittatra samaṃ dravam|
ityevaṃ matabhedāttu yathā kvāthavidhau tathā||
akapa.110
caturguṇodakaḥ pakṣo yadā tatra samāśritaḥ|
bahudravyaṃ kila sneho vīryavāñchatapākavat||
akapa.111
anayaivopapatyā tu samudāyaṃ caturguṇam|
necchanti kecit pratyekamāhuḥ snehasamaṃ dravam||
akapa.112
grahaṇīraugike snehe pañcamūlābhayādike|
śuktena mātuluṅgasya svarasenaivamāditaḥ||
akapa.113
udāharaṇamatrāsti yo vāpyanyo bahudravaḥ|
ślokaireṣoṇutailasya kathyate pākasaṃvidhiḥ||
akapa.114
yasya sādhayituṃ tailaṃ yāvanmātramabhīpsitam|
tatrauṣadhāni tāvanti datvā toyaṃ caturguṇam||
akapa.115
kaṣāyārthaṃ vipacyante yaḥ kaṣāyaścaturguṇaḥ|
yāvanmātrasya tailasya dadyāt pādāvaśeṣitam||
akapa.116
yāvanmātramasau tailāt kaṣāyo nāvatāryate|
caturguṇo'tra kiṃ tarhi pākyāddaśaguṇaḥ kṛtaḥ||
akapa.117
caturguṇena toyena prāptāni paribhāṣayā|
kvāthyāni yāni tānyatra pākyāḥ śataguṇe jale||
akapa.118
kvāthyante paribhāṣā tu śāstravākyena bādhitā|
ityevamaṇutailasya kartavyaṃ samprasādhanam||
akapa.119
gadyokto yaḥ punaḥ ślokairarthaḥ samanugīyate|
tadvyaktivyavasāyārthaṃ dviruktiḥ sā na garhyate|
[prāgukto'pi mayārtho yaḥ ślokaistasmāt prakāśitaḥ||]
||iti aṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ||
<6>
aṣṭāṅgasaṅgrahaḥ
uttarasthānam
atha prathamo'dhyāyaḥ|
au1.1
athāto bālopacaraṇīyaṃ nāmādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ|
iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ||
au1.2
atha khalu jātamātrameva bālamulbāt saindhavasarpiṣā mārjayet||
au1.3
tato'syātiprabalamohajvaraparītasarvagātrasya krośitumapi rujānurūpamasamarthasyānavasthitāśeṣadehadhātorasambhāvyayauvanādyavasthasya krakacasparśamiva karavasanaśayanasaṃsargaṃ manyamānasyāvikalpitamaṅgāni vikṣipataḥ punariva maraṇamanubhavato līyamānasaṃjñasyātisambādhayonipuṭāvapīḍitaprāṇapratyānayanāya balātailena pariṣekaṃ kuryāt|
karṇamūle cāśmanoḥ saṅghaṭṭanam||
au1.4
yadi vāceṣṭa eva syāttataḥ kṛṣṇakapālikayā śūrpeṇa cainamabhiniṣpunīyāt|
dakṣiṇakarṇamūle ca mantrasyoccārayet||
au1.5
aṅgādaṅgāt sambhavasi hṛdayādabhijāyase|
ātmā vai putranāmāsi sa jīva śaradāṃ śatam||
au1.6
śatāyuḥ śatavarṣo'si dīrghamāyuravāpnuhi|
nakṣatrāṇi diśo rātrirahaśca tvābhirakṣatu||
au1.7
pratyāgataprāṇasya ca prakṛtibhūtasya nābhinālaṃ nālābhibandhanāccaturaṅgulasyordhvaṃ kṣaumasūtreṇa badhvā tīkṣṇena śastreṇa vardhayet|
grīvāyāṃ cainamāsajjet|
nābhiṃ ca kuṣṭhatailena secayet||
au1.8
tataḥ kṣīravṛkṣakaṣāyeṇa sarvagandhodakena vā taptatapanīyarajatanirvāpaṇakavoṣṇena kapitthapatrakaṣāyeṇa vā tadvidhena snāpayet||
au1.9
tato'sya suparilikhitanakhayā suprakṣālitopavānayā kārpāsapicvavaguṇṭhitayā dakṣiṇapradeśinyā jihvauṣṭhakaṇṭhamanusukhaṃ pramṛjyāt|
tālu connāmya snehapicunopariṣṭādavaguṇṭhayet||
au1.10
tataścaindrībrāhmīśaṅkhapuṣpīvacākalkaṃ madhughṛtopetaṃ hareṇumātraṃ kuśāgrābhimantritaṃ sauvarṇenāśvatthapatreṇa medhāyurbalajananaṃ prāśayet|
tadvat brāhmībalānantāśatāvaryanyatamacūrṇaṃ vā||
au1.11
tataḥ saindhavopahitena sarpiṣā gabhādakāni vāmayet|
tathāsyoraḥkaṇṭhaviśudhyā lāghavamabhilāṣaśca jāyate||
au1.12
athāsya jātakarma prājāpatyena vidhinā kuryāt|
api ca||
au1.13
sirāṇāṃ hṛdayasthānāṃ vivṛtatvāt prasūtitaḥ|
tṛtīye'hni caturthe vā strīṇāṃ stanyaṃ pravartate||
au1.14
tasmāt prathame'hanyanantāmiśrite madhusarpiṣī mantrapūte trikālaṃ prāśayet|
dvitīye lakṣmaṇāsiddhaṃ sarpistṛtīye ca||
au1.15
tataḥ prāṅnivāritastanyasya svapāṇitalasammitaṃ sarpirdvikālaṃ dāpayedanantaraṃ ca stanyamiṣṭataḥ||
au1.16
aharahaścāsya śrotraśṛṅgāṭakaṃ snehāplutena plotena pracchādayet||
au1.17
prākśirasaṃ cainaṃ kṣaumanicaye saṃveśayeducchīrṣake cāsyābhimantritamudakumbhaṃ sthāpayet dvārapakṣayośca||
au1.18
ādārīvidārībadarīkhadiranimbapīluparūṣakaśākhābhirenaṃ vījayet|
tābhiśca samantataḥ sūttikāgāraṃ parivārayet|
sarṣapātasīkaṇakaṇikāścāntarbahiḥ prakiret|
sāyaṃ prātaśca balim||
au1.19
vraṇoktaiśca guggulvādibhirdhūpaṃ kurvīta|
tathā brāhmaṇotharvavedaviddaśāhaṃ śāntikarma kuryāt|
māyūrīṃ mahāmāyūrīmāryāratnaketudhāriṇīṃ cobhayakālaṃ vācayet||
au1.20
hiṅguvacāturuṣkarakṣoghnaiḥ poṭalikāmuttaradehalyāmāsajjet|
kumārasya ca saha mātrā kaṇṭhe ucchīrṣake ca|
tadvadāryāparṇaśabarīmāryāparājitāṃ ca gorocanābhilikhitām||
au1.21
dvāre ca dehalīmanutiryaṅmusalaṃ nidhāpayet|
kaṇakaṇḍakatindukendhanāgniṃ naktaṃ divaṃ ca jāgṛyāt|
tathānuraktāḥ striyaḥ suhṛdaśca|
prahṛṣṭajanasampūrṇaṃ ca tadveśma kāryam||
au1.22
athāsya samānavarṇā madhyamavayāḥ śuciralolupā nibhṛtānāturā jīvadvatsā vatsalā dakṣiṇā brahmacāriṇyavyaṅgā bahukṣīrā śuklāmbarācarā dīrghadrasvādidehadoṣāṣṭakarahitā alambordhvacucūkātipīnahanistanadoṣamuktā yuktacūcukā dhātrī syāttasyā eva stanyaṃ pibet||
au1.23
taccodakapātre duhyamānamekatāṃ yadudakena saha gacchati vakṣyamāṇadoṣarahitaṃ ca tacchuddhamārogyabalajananam||
au1.24
atha dhātrī snātānuliptā nityamahatavāsāḥ sumanāḥ prajāsthāpanauṣadhīḥ śirasā bibhrāṇā prāṅmukhī stanaṃ prāgdakṣiṇaṃ dhautamīṣatparisrutaṃ pāyayet||
au1.25
nānāstanyasya hyasātmyatvānnānāvidhā vyāpado bhavanti|
aparisrute cātistanyapūrṇastanapānenotsnehanāt kāsaśvāsajvaracchardiṣāṃ sambhavaḥ||
au1.26
rukṣānnapānakarśanakrodhaśokakāmādibhiḥ stanyanāśaḥ|
stanyajananāni tu madyāni śīdhuvarjyānyānūpamāṃsāni dravāḥ svādvamlalavaṇaprāyāścāhārāḥ kṣīriṇyaścauṣadhayaḥ kṣīrapānamanāyāsaḥ saumanasyaṃ ca||
au1.27
na tu kṣudhitaśokārtaśrāntakruddhapraduṣṭadhātuṃgarbhiṇīviruddhāhārabhuktānāṃ stanyaṃ pāyayennājīrṇauṣadhaṃ ca bālamiti|
bhavati cātra||
au1.28
ṣaṣṭīṃ niśāṃ viśeṣeṇa kṛtarakṣābalikriyāḥ|
jāgṛyurbāndhavāstasya dadhataḥ paramāṃ mudam||
au1.29
daśame dvādaśe vāhni gotrācāraiḥ śubhaiḥ śubhe|
sūtā snānotsavaṃ kuryāt pitāpatyasya nāma ca||
au1.30
dine śatatame vākhyāṃ pūrṇe saṃvatsare'thavā|
bibhrato'ṅgairmanohvālarocanāgarucandanam||
au1.31
pūjyaṃ tripuruṣānūkamādau ghoṣavadakṣaram|
avṛddhaṃ kṛtamūṣmāntamanarātipratiṣṭhitam||
au1.32
nakṣatradevatāyuktaṃ tadeva tu na kevalam|
maṅgalyamantarantasthaṃ na duṣṭaṃ na ca taddhitam||
au1.33
puṃso visarjanīyāntaṃ samavarṇaṃ striyāḥ punaḥ|
viṣamākṣaramakrūraṃ vispaṣṭārthaṃ manoramam|
sukhodyaṃ dīrghavarṇāntamāśīrvādābhidhānavat||
au1.34
tataḥ prakṛtibhedoktarūpairāyuḥparīkṣaṇam|
prāgudakśirasaḥkuryāt bālasyajñānavānbhiṣak||
au1.35
praśastavāstuśaraṇaṃ sajjopakaraṇaṃ śuci|
nirvātaṃ ca pravātaṃ ca vṛddhastrīvaidyasevitam||
au1.36
nirmatkuṇākhumaśakamatamaskaṃ ca śasyate|
śucidhautopavānāni nirvalīni mṛdūni ca||
au1.37
śayyāstaraṇavāsāṃsi rakṣoghnairdhūpitāni ca|
kāko'viśastaḥ śastaśca dhūpane trivṛtānvitaḥ|
vacājyakuṣṭhaśrīveṣṭasarṣapairdhūpayet sadā||
au1.38
bodhayet sahasā suptaṃ no na cainaṃ samutkṣipet|
tathāhyasya samutrāso vegarodhaśca jāyate||
au1.39
mākṣikāmalakavyoṣabṛhatīmūlasaindhavaiḥ|
lālāpanodarucyarthaṃ mukhamantaḥ parāmṛśet||
au1.40
jīvatkhaḍgādiśṛṅgeṣu samāsaktāñchubhān maṇīn|
dhārayeddaśa caindryādīñjīvakarṣabhakāvapi||
au1.41
hastābhyāṃ grīvayā mūrdhnā viśeṣāt satataṃ vacām|
āyurmedhāsmṛtisvāsthyakarīṃ rakṣobhirakṣaṇīm||
au1.42
stanyadoṣāt gadāstasya yathoktaṃ tat pibedyataḥ|
pīno'tikandharāstambhaṃ kuryādūrdhvākṣamūrdhvagaḥ||
au1.43
ucchvāsarodhāt laṃbo'tistano jīvitasaṃśayam|
na garbhiṇyāḥ pibet stanyaṃ pārigarbhikakṛddhi tat||
au1.44
stanyābhāve payaśchāgaṃ gavyaṃ vā tadguṇaṃ pibet|
mūlaiḥsiddhaṃ bṛhatyādyaiḥ sthirābhyāṃ vā sitāyutam||
au1.45
caturthe sūtikāgārādagniskandapurogamān|
māse niṣkrāmayeddevān namaskartuṃ svalaṅkṛtam||
au1.46
pañcame māsi puṇye'hni dharaṇyāmupaveśayet|
dvikiṣkumātraṃ liptāyāṃ baliṃ datvā caturdiśam||
au1.47
dharaṇyaśeṣabhūtānāṃ mātā tvamasi kāmadhuk|
ajarā cāprameyā ca sarvabhūtanamaskṛtā||
au1.48
carācarāṇāṃ lokānāṃ pratiṣṭhāsyavyayāsi ca|
kumāraṃ pāhi māteva brahmā tadanumanyatām||
au1.49
svāheti mantreṇānena pratyahaṃ ca tataḥ param|
sāśrayaṃ sāvalambaṃ ca kaṭyādīn mardayedanu||
au1.50
ṣaṣṭhe'nnaprāśanaṃ māsi kramāttacca prayojayet|
cirānniṣevamāṇo'nnaṃ bālo nāturyamaśnute||
au1.51
bhajedyathā yathācānnaṃ stanyaṃ tyājyaṃ tathā tathā|
ṣaṭsaptāṣṭamamāseṣu nīrujasya śubhe'hani|
karṇau himāgame vighyeddhātryaṅkasthasya sāntvayan||
au1.52
prāgdakṣiṇaṃ kumārasya bhiṣagvāmaṃ tu yoṣitaḥ|
dakṣiṇena dadhat sūcīṃ pālīmanyena pāṇinā||
au1.53
madhyataḥ karṇapīṭhasya kiñcit gaṇḍāśayaṃ prati|
jarāyumātrapracchanne raviraśmyavabhāsite||
au1.54
dhṛtasya niścalaṃ samyagalaktakarasāṅkite|
vidhyeddaivakṛte chidre sakṛdevarju lāghavāt||
au1.55
nordhvaṃ na pārśvato nādhaḥ sirāstatra hi saṃśritāḥ||
au1.56
kālikāmarmarīraktāstadvyadhādrāgarugjvarāḥ|
saśophadāhasaṃrambhamanyāstambhāpatānakāḥ|
teṣāṃ yathāmayaṃ kuryādvibhajyāśu cikitsitam||
au1.57
sthānavyadhānna rudhiraṃ na rugrāgādisambhavaḥ|
snehāktaṃ sūcyanusyūtaṃ sūtra cānu nidhāpayet|
āmatailena siñcecca bahalāṃ tadvadārayā||
au1.58
vidhyet pālīṃ hitabhujaḥ sañcāryātha sthavīyasī|
varti stryahāttato rūḍhaṃ vardhayeta śanaiḥ śanaiḥ|
sveditodvartiṃtaṃ karṇamabhyaktaṃ bṛṃhaṇaiḥ punaḥ||
au1.59
nājīṇa na malodreke na cātyuṣṇe'pi vardhayet|
sadā ca yuñjyādabhyaṅgānkarṇapālīgadoditān||
au1.60
puṣṭinīruktvajananāniti saṃvardhite dṛḍhe|
kaladhautāvabaddhāni karṇe ratnāni nikṣipet||
au1.61
bhindyādavṛddhau strīṇāntu pālīmantarapāṅgataḥ|
naiva cāpāṅgayorbāhyāṃ vyāpadaḥ syustato dhruvāḥ||
au1.62
jihmasūcīvyadhādvartigāḍhatvādathavā malaiḥ|
jāte mahati saṃrambhe vartimāśvapanīya tat||
au1.63
yavairaṇḍajaṭāyaṣṭīmañjiṣṭhajyaiḥ pralepayet|
surūḍhaṃ ca punarvidhyat tvarayā tu vivardhanāt||
au1.64
chidyeta pālī śuddhasya śuddhāsrāṃ sandadhīta tām|
karṇāmayaniṣedhoktasandhānavidhinā bhiṣak||
au1.65
varṣaṃ svavasaterbāhyaṃ kumārasya na darśayet|
dīpamātapamagniṃ ca rūpamanyacca bhāsuram||
au1.66
athainaṃ jātadaśanaṃ kramaśo'panayet stanāt|
pūrvoktaṃ yojayet kṣīramannaṃ ca laghu bṛṃhaṇam||
au1.67
kuryādapastanaṃ snehasaṅkrāntyā stanalepanaiḥ|
bībhatsairyāvakāsekakṛtrimakṣatadarśanaiḥ||
au1.68
priyālamajjamadhukamadhulājasitopalaiḥ|
apastanyasya saṃyojyaḥ prīṇano modakaḥ śiśoḥ||
au1.69
dīpano bālabilvailāśarkarālājasaktubhiḥ|
saṅgrāhī dhātakīpuṣpaśarkarālājatarpaṇaiḥ||
au1.70
bubhukṣā cet prabalatāmapastanyasya gacchati|
atyagnijiddhitaṃ tasya vidhānaṃ pārigarbhikam||
au1.71
abhiyuktaḥ sadācāro nātisthūlo na lolupaḥ|
kumāradhāraḥ katavyastatrādyo bālacittavit||
au1.72
aghārmikaṃ durācāraḥ sthūlo vikaṭagāminam|
karoti lolupo bālaṃ ghasmaratvena rogiṇam||
au1.73
rogāṃścāsya jayet saumyairbheṣajairaviṣādakaiḥ|
anyatrātyayikādvyādhervirekaṃ sutarāṃ tyajet||
au1.74
trāsayennāvidheyaṃ ca trastaṃ gṛhvanti hi grahāḥ|
vastrapātāt parasparśāt pālayellaṅghanācca tam||
au1.75
krīḍābhūmiḥ samā kāryā niśśastropalaśarkarā|
velloṣaṇakaṇāmbhobhiḥ siktā nimbodakena vā||
au1.76
jātuṣaṃ ghoṣavaccitramatrāsaṃ ramaṇaṃ bṛhat|
atīkṣṇāgraṃ gavāśvādimaṅgalyamatha vā phalam||
au1.77
śaktimantaṃ yathāvarṇaṃ vidyāmadhyāpayettataḥ|
anuśiṣyāt sadā cainaṃ dharmāya vinayāya ca||
au1.78
yathā nendriyaduṣṭāśvairdriyate yauvanāgame|
abhyaṅgodvartanaṃ snānaṃ pratyahaṃ ca samācaret|
sahadevāsthirākauntīkumudotpalacandanaiḥ||
au1.79
bṛhatīphalatarkārīsarṣapākuṣṭhasaindhavaiḥ|
aśvagandhābalairaṇḍatilāpāmārgataṇḍulaiḥ||
au1.80
sātmaguptāphalaistailaṃ sājakṣīraṃ vipācitam|
rakṣoghnaḥ puṣṭido'bhyaṅgastadvadudvartanaṃ ca taiḥ||
au1.81
dadhimākṣikasaṃyuktaistriguṇīkṛtacikkasaiḥ|
mūrvāmūladvirajanīyavaiścodvartanaṃ hitam||
au1.82
kulatthacūrṇamekaṃ vā vājigandhārajo'pi vā|
snāne sarvauṣadhīkalko jīvanīyāmbu ceṣyate||
au1.83
āragvadhādiniryūhe śṛtaṃ śītavasantayoḥ|
vatsakādipratīvāpaṃ kumāraṃ prāśayet ghṛtam||
au1.84
grīṣme vātātapasvedairbālaḥ klāmyatyato himam|
prātareva pibeddugdhaṃ jīvanīyagaṇaiḥ śṛtam||
au1.85
sitāghṛtāḍhyān saktūṃśca lihyānnatveva pītakam|
nātyambupāyī lihyādvā ghṛtasātmyo ghṛtaṃ śṛtam||
au1.86
kākolīśarkarāmedātugāyaṣṭyāhvajīvakaiḥ|
kaṭunnaṭena mūrdhānaṃ limpedanyaiśca śītalaiḥ||
au1.87
rāsnāsaralavarṣābhūhiṅgusaindhavadārubhiḥ|
sarpirvidāryādijale sādhitaṃ lehayecchiśum||
au1.88
prapauṇḍarīkaṃ madhukaṃ sūpyaparṇyau durālabhā|
priyālamajjākākolīvidārīkaṭphalāmṛtāḥ||
au1.89
drākṣājaśṛṅgī dugdhīkā kṣīraśuklā hayāhvayā|
śṛṅgīmadhūkakusumamedarṣabhakajīvakam||
au1.90
ebhiḥ kṣīraghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ lihyāt bālo ghanātyaye| brāhmīsiddhārthakavacāsārivākuṣṭhasaindhavaiḥ||
au1.91
sakaṇaiḥ sādhitaṃ pītaṃ vāṅmedhāsmṛtikṛt ghṛtam|
āyuṣyaṃ pāpmarakṣoghnaṃ bhūtonmādanibarhaṇam||
au1.92
triphalā lakṣmaṇānantā samaṅgā sārivā vacā|
brāhmī pāṭhā dvibṛhatī dvisthirā dvipunarnavam||
au1.93
sahadevā ravervallī payasyā girikarṇikā|
toyakumbhe pacedetat palāṃśaṃ pādaśeṣitam||
au1.94
tena kauntīvacākuṣṭhakṛṣṇāsarṣapasaindhavaiḥ|
nīruksarūpavatsāyāḥ saṃyuktaṃ payasā ca goḥ||
au1.95
puṣyayoge ghṛtaprasthaṃ sahemaśakalaṃ śṛtam|
pānābhyañjanato medhāsmṛtyāyuḥpuṣṭibuddhidam||
au1.96
rakṣoghnaṃ ca viṣaghnaṃ ca sārasvatamidaṃ ghṛtam|
līḍhaṃ vā saghṛtakṣaudraṃ vacāhemarajo'lpaśaḥ|
saṃvatsaraṃ paraṃ medhyaṃ rakṣoghnaṃ vāgvivardhanam||
au1.97
vayasthā pippalī kuṣṭhaṃ haridrā sārivā vacā|
māṃsī kaiḍaryamityetaccūrṇaṃ brāhmīrajaḥsamam||
au1.98
līḍhvājyena śiśurvarṣaṃ bhavatyapalito'vyathaḥ|
balavān śrutasampannaḥ śatāyuḥ sthirayauvanaḥ|
prātaḥ prātarimaṃ lehaṃ dhātrīṃ cāsyāvalehayet||
au1.99
brāhmīvadyojayeddūrvāṃ mūrvāṃ brahmasuvarcalām|
lakṣmaṇāṃ śvetatarkārīmavyaṇḍāṃ gaurasarṣapām||
au1.100
sahasravīryāṃ phalinīṃ pakvaṃ ca bṛṃhatīphalam|
rohiṣaṃ cetyamīprāśāḥ pṛthagdvādaśa kīrtitāḥ||
au1.101
mahatāpyupayoktavyā nareṇa niyatātmanā|
nityaṃ mṛdbhakṣaṇādrakṣettayā syurniyataṃ gadāḥ||
au1.102
pāṇḍutvaśvayathuśvāsakāsātīsārajantavaḥ|
chardiṃmūrchāgnisadanastanyadveṣāṅgarugbhramāḥ||
au1.103
bhakṣayeddantapavanaṃ nāsthiradvijabbandhanaḥ|
tasya tatghaṭṭanāt kruddhaḥ kuryāddantāmayānmarut||
au1.104
śūrairāyudhibhirguptamadhṛṣyaṃ nagaraṃ paraiḥ|
yathā śiśorvapustadvadyathoktairvidhibhirgrahaiḥ||
||iti prathamo'dhyāyaḥ||
atha dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ|
au2.1
athāto bālāmayapratiṣedhaṃ nāmādhyāyaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ|
iti ha smāhurātreyādayo maharṣayaḥ||
au2.2
trividho hi bālaḥ prāguktastatra kṣīrapasya kṣīramaduṣṭaṃ prayuñjīta|
annādasya hitamannam|
ubhayavṛtterubhayam||
au2.3
kṣīraṃ hi yathoktairdoṣakopanairāhāravihārairdhātryā vyāpannaṃ vividhāmayodayāya bālasya prakalpate||
au2.4
tatra śyāvāruṇavarṇaṃ tiktakaṣāyānurasaṃ viśadaṃ rūkṣamalakṣyagandhaṃ phenilamatṛptikaramādhmānamūtravarcovibandhakṛt karśanamapsu visarpati vicchinnaṃ ca plavate vātaduṣṭam||
au2.5
kṛṣṇanīlatāmrāvabhāsaṃ tiktāmlakaṭukānurasaṃ kuṇaparudhiragandhi bhṛśoṣṇamapsu pītarājimadvidāhakaraṃ ca pittaduṣṭam||
au2.6
atyarthaśuklamadhuraṃ lavaṇānurasaṃ ghṛtatailavasāmajjagandhi picchilaṃ bahalaṃ tantumat guru salile'vasīdati nidrābahulaṃ ca śleṣmaduṣṭam||
au2.7
tadupayujyamānaṃ yathāsvaliṅgān vyādhīnabhinirvartayati||
au2.8
sa yaṃ pradeśamabhīkṣṇaṃ spṛśati sparśaṃ ca na kṣamate tatra rujamupalakṣayet||
au2.9
nimīlitākṣatayā mūrdhni rujam|
jihvauṣṭhadaṃśaśvāsamuṣṭivandhordhvekṣaṇairhṛdaye|
viṇmūtracchardyādhmānāntrakūjanastanadaṃśaveṣṭanapṛṣṭhavinamanajaṭharonnamanairjaṭhare|
mūtrasaṅgatṛṇmūrcchotrāsadigvīkṣaṇakhallīhastapādastambhakubjībhavanakeśaluñcanairbastau guhye ca sarvatra ca svabhā vātiriktarodanena mukhavikūṇanena ca||
au2.10
atha yathāmayaṃ yathādoṣaṃ ca dhātryāḥ śamanaśodhanāni prayuñjīta||
au2.11
tatra vātadūṣite stanye devadārusaralakaṭurohiṇīvacākuṣṭhapāṭhābhārṅgīmāgadhikāvṛścikālīcitrakājamodaśuṇṭhīmarīcānāṃ kvāthaṃ daśamūlakvāthaṃ vā trirātraṃ pāyayitvā vātavyādhivihitānāṃ sarpiṣāmanyatamaṃ nigadamadirānupānaṃ dadyādvātaharadravyasiddhaṃ vā|
tataḥ snigdhāṃ mṛdu virecya bastikarmaṇopacaret|
vātaghnaiścābhyaṅgasvedopadehonmardanaiḥ|
saralarāsnājamodādevadārucūrṇaṃ sarpiṣā bālamavalehayet|
evaṃvidhaireva ca vipakvaṃ saśarkaraṃ sarpiḥ||
au2.12
api ca|
tiktānurasaṃ stanyaṃ mudgamāṣapalāśābhyāṃ kākolīyugalena ca śodhayet|
priyaṅgudhātakīpuṣpapadmakadevadārukṣaudrairvā|
kaṣāyānurasaṃ hiṅgusaindhavavatā ghṛtena|
phenilaṃ vicchinnaṃ plavamānaṃ ca bilvāgnimanthaśṛtena payasā haviṣā ca|
sūpyaparṇī kākolībṛhatyavalgujaphalairvā||
au2.13
pitte'mṛtāpaṭolapatrasārivāśatāvarīnimbacandanakvāthaṃ dhātrī bālaśca pibet|
triphalābhūnimbakaṭukāmustakvāthaṃ vā|
jīvakarṣabhakadvikākolīmadhukakaṭphalakarkaṭaśṛṅgīkvāthaṃ vā|
sakṣaudraṃ paṭolādiṃ padmakādiṃ vā|
sārivādiṃ nyagrodhādiṃ vā|
ebhireva ca dravyaiḥ sarpīṣi pittaghnāni ca virecanāni śītāṃścābhyaṅgapradehasekān kuryāt||
au2.14
api ca|
tāmrāvabhāsaṃ payo hṛdayamudveṣṭayati|
tatpriyaṅgumustāśābaraloddhraiḥ śodhayet|
amlānurasamamlapittakaram|
tat drākṣāmadhukapayasyāśrīparṇībhiḥ|
kaṭukānurasaṃ chardyatīsārakāsaśvāsakaram|
tat kākolīvidārībhyāṃ madhuparṇyā ca|
bhṛśoṣṇamanāmadāhajvarakaraṃ virecanaṃ ca taccandanotpalakamalaiḥ||
au2.15
kaphe tu saindhavapippalīyuktaṃ sarpirbālaṃ pāyayet|
saindhavamadhukasaṃsṛṣṭaṃ vā madanapuṣpakalkena ca sakṣaudreṇa stanaṃ bālasya coṣṭhamālimpet|
tena sukhaṃ vamati|
dhātrīṃ tu tīkṣṇairvāmayet|
tataḥ kṛtasaṃsarjanāṃ pañcamūlaghanavacātiviṣākvāthaṃ pāyayet|
tagarasuradārusurendrayavapṛthvīkāvṛścikālīkvāthaṃ vā|
āragvadhādiṃ mustādiṃ vā|
rūkṣoṣṇāṃśca nasyadhūmagaṇḍūṣapradehapariṣekān śīlayet|
aviruddhaṃ cānnapānaṃ yojayet||
au2.16
api ca|
lavaṇānurasaṃ visarpakoṭhakaṇḍūkaram|
tat picumandapaṭolīkṣīrīvṛkṣaiḥ śodhayet|
tantumaddaurbalyaśvāsakāsakaram|
tat pippalīnāgaracūrṇena samadhughṛtena|
guru sadanātmakaṃ pratiśyāyasiṅghāṇakakṣīrālasakakaram|
tat pāṭhāvyoṣakalkena pañcakolacūrṇena vā kṣaudraghṛtāplutena|
doṣopakramaṇīyaṃ cekṣeta||
au2.17
yadā punardhātrī sannipātaprakopanānyāseveta tadasyāstrayo malā yugapadvakṣo'bhiprapannāḥ kṣīravahā rasāyanīḥ samanusṛtya saṅgīrṇaliṅgaṃ stanyamāvahanti|
taccedavijñānāt satatamapratyavekṣaṇāt pramādādvā mātuḥ kumāraḥ pibati tataḥ sa tena salilopamamacchaṃ vicchinnamāmaṃ durgandhi nānāvarṇavedanaṃ phenilamatisāryate|
pītaśvetamūtratāviṣṭambhatṛṣṇājvaracchardivijṛmbhikāśuṣkodgārārucibhramāṅgabhaṅgavikṣepakūjanaghrāṇākṣimukhapākadṛṣṭyupaplavasvarasādādayaścāsya prādurbhavanti|
taṃ kṣīrālasakamatyayaṃ cācakṣate||
au2.18
tatra dhātrīṃ bālaṃ ca pūrvamevāśu vāmayet|
vihitasaṃsargayośca mustāpāṭhātiviṣākuṣṭhakaṭukānāṃ kvāthaṃ pānāya dadyāt|
rāsnājamodāpriyaṅgubhadradārūṇāṃ vā|
pāṭhātejovatīpunarnavavṛścikālīnāṃ vā|
bhūnimbāmṛtākuṭajaphalasārivāṇāṃ vā|
vacāharidrādigaṇayorvā|
pāṭhādimahākaṣāyasya vā|
jambvāmratindukakapitthapatrāṇāṃ vā|
bilvabhaṅgasya vā|
anubandhe ca yathāvyādhi pratikurvīta||
au2.19
dantodbhedaśca sarvarogāyatanam|
viśeṣeṇa tu tanmūlā jvaraśirobhitāpatṛṣṇābhramābhiṣyandakukūṇakapothakīvamathukāsaśvāsātīsāravisarpāḥ||
au2.20
sa dīrghāyuṣo'ṣṭamānmāsāt parato vā pravartate|
itareṣāṃ tu caturthāt|
tehyatibālye dantotpādavedanayātipīḍitā na samyak sampūrṇadhātubalā bhavanti||
au2.21
tatrāsthimajjānau dantotpattihetū|
tadā ca tayorasampūrṇavīryatvāt punaḥ kālāntareṇa dantānāṃ patanamāpūryamāṇadhātutvācca punarutthānamata eva ca vṛddhānāṃ na punardantotpattiḥ||
au2.22
balānnipatitānāṃ tu sahasā tadadhiṣṭhānagatadhātubījabhraṃśāt santativyucchedācchoṇitātipravṛtyābhighātācca nissāritatvāt|
sirāṇāṃ punaranutpādaḥ etena rogacyutā api prāyaśo vyākhyātāḥ||
au2.23
tau tu dhātū kālakrameṇa pacyamānau yadā dantāśayamanuprapadyete tadāsya kiñcidutsedhenordhvādhodantamāṃsasaṅghaṭṭanādaṅgaharṣo jāyate|
tadgatena ca śleṣmaṇā kaṇḍūstayā cūcukaṃ daśyate|
yadyadālabhate tattadāsyamānayati|
mārutaścāsya dantamūleṣu mūrchati|
tataḥ sa kaphānuviddho'sthimajjasthitaḥ sarvato visaran saha pittena dhātūn malāṃśca dūṣayan vividhānyathoditānupadravānabhinirvartayati||
au2.24
yadā punardantamāṃsāśrayī kevalo vikṛtaḥ prabalo'nilaḥ sapitto vāsthimajjānau śoṣayati tadā dvijānāmasambhava eveti|
bhavanti cātra||
au2.25
pṛṣṭhabhaṅge biḍālānāṃ barhiṇāṃ ca śikhodgame|
dantodbhede ca bālānāṃ na hi kiñcinna dūyate||
au2.26
yathādoṣaṃ yathārogaṃ yathodrekaṃ yathābalam|
vibhajya deśakālādīṃstatra yojyaṃ bhiṣagjitam||
au2.27
ta eva doṣā dūṣyāśca jvarādyā vyādhayaśca yat|
atastadeva bhaiṣajyaṃ mātrā tvasya kanīyasī|
saukumāryālpakāyatvāt sarvānnānupasevanāt||
au2.28
snigdhā eva sadā bālā ghṛtakṣīraniṣevaṇāt|
sadyastān vamanaṃ tasmāt pāyayenmatimānmṛdu||
au2.29
bastiṃ sādhye virekeṇa marśena pratimarśanam|
yuñjyādvirecanādīṃstu dhātryā eva yathocitān||
au2.30
mūrvāvyoṣavarākolajambūtvagdārusarṣapāḥ|
sapāṭhā madhunā līḍhāḥ stanyadoṣaharāḥ param||
au2.31
ikṣumūlakaśervākhyayaṣṭyāhvaistanu śudhyati|
sāndraṃ tu kṣaudrakāśmaryaguḍūcītaṇḍulāmbubhiḥ||
au2.32
śṛtairvā surasaśvetasarṣapābṛhatīdvayaiḥ|
grathitaṃ padmakośīraphalinīśvetacandanaiḥ||
au2.33
dantapālīṃ samadhunā cūrṇena pratisārayet|
pippalyā dhātakīpuṣpadhātrīphalakṛtena vā||
au2.34
vādhrīṇasakapotottharajastadvacca yojitam|
lāvatittirivallūrarajaḥ puṣparasadrutam||
au2.35
drutaṃ karoti bālānāṃ dantakesaravanmukham|
vacādvibṛhatīpāṭhākaṭukātiviṣāghanaiḥ|
madhuraiśca ghṛtaṃ siddhaṃ siddhaṃ daśanajanmani||
au2.36
bhadradāru ghanaṃ yaṣṭī samaṅgā sasitopalā|
vātajvaraparītāṅgaḥ pibedantarapānakam||
au2.37
surāhvaghanayaṣṭyāhvapayasyāṃśumatīdvayam|
nāgaraṃ maricaṃ bhārṅgī vṛścikālī śatāvarī||
au2.38
ghṛtaṃ tatkvāthadugdhābhyāṃ siddhaṃ hantyanilajvaram|
bālasya pānābhyaṅgābhyāmebhiśconmardanaṃ hitam||
au2.39
haridrākuṣṭhaṣaṅgranthāśatapuṣpāhareṇubhiḥ|
bhārṅgyelāsuṣavīrāsnāvarṣābhūnatasarṣapaiḥ||
au2.40
akṣāṃśaiḥ sāmbusauvīrairmastupiṣṭairmarujjvare|
